name: Pomodoro
tagline: Focus timer with work/break cycles for Even G2.
description: Pomodoro technique timer for Even G2. 25-minute work sessions with 5-minute short breaks and a 15-minute long break after every 4 sessions. Swipe to choose Start / Pause, Skip or Reset and tap to confirm. When a phase ends the status line blinks and the timer waits for you, and your session is kept if the app is closed.
author: Marcelo
